reasons: UNSUPPORTED: "'bis zum Ende der siebten Staffel' zu viel getrunken" (Source says he was drinking too much, with no timing to the end of season seven. Delete 'bis zum Ende der siebten Staffel'.)

Reviewer recommends rejection: Nearly all claims check out against the opened sources. Reject for one unsupported detail: 'bis zum Ende der siebten Staffel' is not in the TVLine source (delete it). Also, the German text is built on English sources with no German-language sourcing or local context, so it needs localising before approval.

claims.claim: Geburtsdatum 27. August 1981, Toronto (Summary, Body, FAQ)

claims.claim: Kanadischer Schauspieler; Staatsbürgerschaft Kanada

claims.claim: Mike Ross in Suits, Sender USA, 23. Juni 2011 bis 25. September 2019, neun Staffeln, 134 Folgen
claims.note: TV Series Finale: network USA, June 23 2011 to September 25 2019, nine seasons, 134 episodes, Mike Ross played by Patrick J. Adams.

claims.note: Article says he was referring to having panic attacks on stage.

claims.claim: Anfrage als Ehre, nicht gewusst, ob er sie bewältigt
claims.note: Re-checked: 'it would be an honor' and 'I just don't know that I can do it'.

claims.claim: Regisseur Scott Ellis: dies sei seine Chance, das in den Griff zu bekommen (paraphrase, no quote marks)
claims.note: Source: 'this is your chance to fix that, essentially'. Paraphrase is faithful.

claims.claim: Adams gab zu, er sei natürlich verängstigt gewesen
claims.note: 'I was terrified, obviously'.

claims.claim: Nach der siebten Staffel stieg Adams aus
claims.note: Just Jared: season 7 was his last.

claims.note: Source says he started thinking about leaving at the end of the first half of season six, after Mike's release.

claims.claim: Zitat: 'Wir haben seine Geschichte erzählt ... Mike ist einfach nur ein weiterer Anwalt im Fernsehen'

claims.note: Source says he was drinking too much, with no timing to the end of season seven. Delete 'bis zum Ende der siebten Staffel'.

valueNote: Adds a sourced timeline of the Suits exit, the Right Stuff prep and the hoax correction, with the Take Me Out details. Sources are almost all English-language press and primary bodies; no German-language source is used, and the German text follows the English structure closely, which the style guide says needs localising.
summary: Nearly all claims check out against the opened sources. Reject for one unsupported detail: 'bis zum Ende der siebten Staffel' is not in the TVLine source (delete it). Also, the German text is built on English sources with no German-language sourcing or local context, so it needs localising before approval.
